dict.string: So nice of your friend to work for you ! Don't forget to help other back !
Humans are hard working, fun loving little creatures that are more likely to buy products than robots.
Engineers spent most of their youth in engineering school trying to build a super hero suit. Sadly only 95% will ever succeed.
Fat Cheez is from the hood. Harvard hood, he's actually graduated and has a PHD in Quantum Physics. A man does what neeeds to be done..
CatMan is your city superHero. He fights the crime and panel gap. He can also bake a super good chipotle.
Doc is the man when it comes to building wacky machines. He's sometimes a little weird but trust him he's an engineer !
Mr. Coffee doesn't like planes, cause Mr. Coffee ain't no bird FOOL ! Once he built a truck out of boogers.
Princess Z is a Warrior with a capital Z. If she could be reborn in fire with dragons she would. But she can't.
Tonio GoodBeat can make the summer hit while assembling a car. This DJ never drop his hammer, but the bass: YES HE DID !
"I walk the Assembly line" is Johnny Coin's biggest hit.
Working Point is strong with this one. And.. I think he's your father but don't tell your mom.
This man can really build ANYTHING. Including his own nuclear powered toaster.
This one almost NEVER eats donuts !! But he's slow..
Slim Cheddar is a very rare worker, he only appears when he wants too. Some says he walks 8 mile each morning...
Zombie Doc was found in the lab chewing a door, he's of a better use on the assembly line if you ask me !!
Her style is explosive and she broke Fat Cheez heart already twice, but give her a hammer and she rocks !
Rosanna... her name is an ode to poetry and love ! She's the best worker around...
Michael Harbor is a very famous director. He has an explosive mind and work very fast !
Scary Mike has some shady connection but he works really well.
Jean is super fast and agile, he's probably one of the best racer in the world !
Locos is insane in the membrane for sure... but give him an hammer and he'll do marvel.
